name: Copperpot
look: a small round riveted copper kettle with a cheerful face, a spout, a handle, a whistling lid and stubby legs
entry: A small, round, riveted copper kettle with stubby legs and a whistling lid. It collects morning dew and rainwater inside its hollow body, keeping it remarkably pure.
how: Wild: common in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
